name: Wingdaria Destiny
source: Wingdaria Destiny is a voiced Visual Novel about 2 lovers, trying to escape their fate. It the trust between them strong enough or will they perish and never reach true freedom?
translation: 《Wingdaria Destiny》是一部有配音的视觉小说，讲述两名恋人试图逃离命运的故事。他们之间的信任足够坚定吗？还是他们会死去，永远无法获得真正的自由？
